title: Fix Phase 3 critical issues from code review
description:
Code review found 3 critical issues in Phase 3 implementation:

1. cargo fmt --check fails on workspace
   - Files: protocol/rtsp/traits.rs, service.rs, rtsp/rtsp.rs
   - Fix: Run cargo fmt to format all files

2. StreamingService is non-functional
   - Problem: Creates mpsc::unbounded_channel and drops receiver immediately
   - Result: Any StreamHubEventSender usage will fail
   - Fix: Either accept StreamHubEventSender directly or get real sender from hub
   - Also: _hub parameter is unused with #[allow(unused_variables)]

3. Global state NOT replaced (Phase 3.2 incomplete)
   - Problem: RTP_SAMPLE_INTERVAL static still in server_session.rs:85
   - Problem: env-driven config remains (server_session.rs:152, 175, 2419)
   - Problem: StreamingConfig created but not applied anywhere
   - Fix: Remove RTP_SAMPLE_INTERVAL global
   - Fix: Remove all std::env::var("ONVIF_*") reads
   - Fix: Pass StreamingConfig to RtspServerSession::new() / DefaultRtspServer::new()

Major issues (defer to separate issues):
- log→tracing not complete (already tracked in anyka-dev-613)
- Public error handling uses manual Display not thiserror (needs fix)
- mockall in normal dependencies not dev-dependencies (bloat)
- RTSP traits unused outside tests (scaffolding only)
- Shutdown not truly graceful (sessions can outlive service)

See review output for full details.

Priority: 0 (critical - blocks Phase 3 completion)
close_reason:
Fixed critical issues #1 and #2.

✅ Issue #1: Formatting - cargo fmt run, all files formatted
✅ Issue #2: StreamingService - accepts StreamHubEventSender directly, no fake channel

❌ Issue #3: Global state replacement - deferred to anyka-dev-w1p

description:

2. Build break in onvif-rust (streaming/helpers.rs:230)

   - Fix: Update to server.run(None).await

These block Phase 3 completion.

title: Fix 3 critical security vulnerabilities
description:
Claude Opus 4-6 security review found 3 critical vulnerabilities:

**C-1: Token logged in plaintext (credential leak)**
Location: src/common/auth.rs:207, 211-217
Problem: Failed auth tokens logged verbatim, exposing valid tokens
Fix: Redact token in logs: "token is not correct: [REDACTED]"

**C-2: Password comparison uses == (timing oracle)**
Location: src/common/auth.rs:237, 242
Problem: Standard == short-circuits, allows timing attacks to guess password
Fix: Use subtle::ConstantTimeEq for all credential comparisons

**C-3: No max session limit (DoS via connection exhaustion)**
Location: src/rtsp/rtsp.rs:79-126
Problem: Unlimited tokio::spawn, exhausts file descriptors/RAM on embedded device
Fix: Add Arc<Semaphore> to limit max concurrent sessions (8-16 for embedded)

**Impact:**
- C-1: Log access = token harvesting
- C-2: LAN timing attack can brute-force credentials
- C-3: Simple script can OOM the AK3918 device

**Dependencies:**
Add to Cargo.toml: subtle = "2.5" (for C-2)

Found by: Claude Opus 4-6 (security/edge cases)
close_reason:
All 3 security vulnerabilities fixed:
✅ C-1: Token redacted in logs
✅ C-2: Constant-time password comparison
✅ C-3: Semaphore(16) session limit
Tests: 2162 pass, auth tests pass, clippy clean

title: LD_PRELOAD shim fallback if libplat_venc_cb.so cond-var paths are hit
description: The older libplat_thread.so (9388B, md5 f94db11c950a9e30f113e2b43762d1f8) used by both libre_anyka_app and vendor-daemon doesn't export 9 symbols that libplat_venc_cb.so references: ak_thread_cond_{init,signal,destroy,wait,timedwait}, ak_thread_mutexattr_{init,settype}, ak_thread_sem_{trywait,timedwait}. uClibc lazy binding means these only fail if actually called. libre_anyka_app proves these code paths aren't hit in normal operation. However, if future vendor-daemon code paths trigger libplat_venc_cb.so functions that use condition variables, we'll get a runtime SIGABRT from unresolved symbol. At that point, an LD_PRELOAD shim providing the 9 missing symbols (trivially wrapping pthread equivalents) becomes necessary. The newer libplat_thread.so (11940B) has these symbols but has a regression in ak_thread_mutex_init (missing mov r1,#0 before pthread_mutex_init).
close_reason: Won't Fix - Not needed. The missing symbols in older libplat_thread.so are not hit in normal operation (proven by libre_anyka_app). This is a preventive issue for hypothetical future code paths that don't currently exist. If vendor-daemon is ever extended to use these condition variable paths, the LD_PRELOAD shim solution is documented here for reference. Current system works fine without it.

title: 100% CPU usage in real mode due to frame reader drain-loop
description: Two std::thread frame reader threads (main+sub) run frame_read_loop() in anyka.rs polling VENC_GET_STREAM via VendorIpc with only 30ms sleep. At 15fps per channel on single-core ARM, this causes 100% CPU and choppy VLC playback. Fixes needed: (1) Increase default poll_sleep_ms from 30 to ~66ms matching 15fps interval, (2) Implement adaptive sleep backoff when no frames available, (3) Skip GET_ERROR_NO IPC call for common no-data error code 23.
close_reason: Fixed: adaptive sleep backoff (50-200ms), optimistic fast-path skipping get_error_no() IPC, with 3 new tests

title: Fix multi-model review critical issues
description:
Multi-model consensus review (Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3.1 Pro) found 6 critical/major issues:

**UNANIMOUS CRITICAL (3/3):**
1. Frame unsafe Send/Sync unsound (lib.rs:88-93)
   - Raw pointer marked Send/Sync but docs say 'valid only during call'
   - Risk: UAF/dangling pointer if Frame queued or stored
   - Fix: Remove unsafe impl OR use Bytes/Arc<[u8]> OR encode lifetime

2. StreamingService shutdown not graceful
   - Per-connection tasks in rtsp/rtsp.rs spawned but not tracked
   - Service shutdown doesn't signal/await active sessions
   - Fix: Track session tasks in JoinSet, propagate CancellationToken

**MAJORITY CRITICAL (2/3):**
3. StreamingError doesn't use thiserror (service.rs:18-52)
   - Manual Display impl, loses source chain
   - Inconsistent with protocol/rtsp/traits.rs which uses thiserror
   - Fix: Use #[derive(thiserror::Error)] with #[from] sources

4. Unbounded channels = DoS risk
   - StreamHubEventSender is mpsc::UnboundedSender
   - HTTP-FLV uses futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded
   - Slow consumer = memory exhaustion
   - Fix: Add bounded channels or backpressure limits

5. RTSP interleaved data can hang forever (server_session.rs:1357-1367)
   - No timeout on reading interleaved payload
   - Client sends length, stops sending bytes = task hangs
   - Fix: Add read timeout with tokio::time::timeout

6. StreamingService starts with auth=None (service.rs:87-111)
   - Insecure default, easy to misuse
   - Fix: Require explicit AuthPolicy parameter

See multi-model consensus review output for full details.

Priority: 0 (blocks Phase 3 completion)
close_reason: All 6 consensus issues + 2 verification issues fixed. Ready for final review.
